title: Generate Binary Strings Without Adjacent Zeros
description:
You are given a positive integer n.
A binary string x is valid if all substrings of x of length 2 contain at least one "1".
Return all valid strings with length n, in any order.
 
Example 1:

Input: n = 3
Output: ["010","011","101","110","111"]
Explanation:
The valid strings of length 3 are: "010", "011", "101", "110", and "111".

Example 2:

Input: n = 1
Output: ["0","1"]
Explanation:
The valid strings of length 1 are: "0" and "1".

 
Constraints:

1 <= n <= 18

    def validStrings(self, n: int) -> List[str]:

check_function:
def check(candidate):
    assert sorted(candidate(1)) == ["0", "1"]
    assert sorted(candidate(2)) == ["01", "10", "11"]
    assert sorted(candidate(3)) == ["010", "011", "101", "110", "111"]
    assert sorted(candidate(4)) == ["0101", "0110", "0111", "1010", "1011", "1101", "1110", "1111"]
    assert len(candidate(5)) == 13
    assert "000" not in candidate(5)
